decisions.reason: The distributed ALCMS controller builds directly on the firm's core airfield lighting and control knowledge, so it can interpret field results and keep improving the product through its own R&D.

The air situation display is linked to the firm's airport systems portfolio but sits further from its electrical lighting core, which lowers its absorptive fit, though it still complements the firm's surveillance and ATC offerings.
The airport systems training program draws on knowledge the firm already holds, costs little to sustain and supports customer relationships, so management keeps it.
The airfield ground lighting course rests directly on the firm's core lighting expertise and supports sales of its main products, so it fits the existing knowledge base well.

The collaboration software is the furthest from the firm's electrical equipment core, which makes its results harder to learn from, but A-CDM software fits the firm's broader airport systems strategy, so management keeps it under observation.

The multilateration system needs specialised surveillance knowledge that only partly overlaps with the firm's base, but it was launched recently with a strong announcement and integrates with its surface movement guidance systems, so it is retained.
